implementation_timing: after stage-1 observed panels; choices below are mechanical operationalizations of the predeclared null families and apply uniformly to every cell
positive_gate: cells with observed loss_gain <= 0 fail the predeclared positive predictive-increment requirement and receive p=1 without stochastic draws; they remain members of BH
training_policy: fit the frozen baseline and challenger once on the unchanged chronological training fold; stochastic nulls alter validation-time predictor alignment only, so training outcomes are never repeatedly re-used to choose a null fit

a2_a3.circular_shift: jointly circular-shift the signed-flow challenger columns on each unique source-market 30s validation grid within event/regime; minimum absolute shift is 10 grid rows = 300s
a2_a3.block_shift: jointly circular-shift the signed-flow challenger columns by whole 300s blocks within each source market/event/regime validation grid
a2_a3.a3_source_unit: source_condition_id; one source-time transformed value is mapped consistently to every target pair
a2_a3.sign_permutation: NOT_RUN_FROM_AGGREGATED_PANEL: mechanical token-side constraints cannot be revalidated after fill aggregation; this omission cannot rescue a failed mechanism
a2_a3.matched_unrelated_family: separate negative-control diagnostic; never used to select a source edge

a4.identity_null: permute validation fill participant identities within event/regime/market_family/300s-block/TAKER strata; historical score state remains past-only and is queried using the permuted validation identity
a4.concentration: report deterministic top-1/top-5/top-10 participant-volume removal and largest-wallet single ablation; wallet ranking uses unsigned taker value only, never response outcomes

a5.liquidity: same validation-time circular and whole-300s-block signed-flow shifts as A2 on the condition grid
a5.maker: validation-time challenger rows are circularly shifted within event/regime/condition only when the paired row timestamps are all at least 300s apart; whole-block null is reported only where a lossless block shift is structurally available
a5.capture_placebos: raw-record, repeated-unchanged and depth-snapshot response cells are null-tested/reported separately and can explain, never promote, a genuine-liquidity result

multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg within each declared mechanism family across PRE/ACTIVE and all five declared horizons; A5 liquidity BH applies to the three primary continuous response families, while capture placebos remain diagnostics
